tg.welcome: Hello! I am the bot of the Chinor Park residential complex — a training project. I can open the floor plans, follow your booking and connect you with a manager.
tg.choose_lang: Выберите язык · Tilni tanlang · Choose a language
tg.menu_hint: Pick an action in the menu below.
tg.soon: This feature is coming soon. For now you can open the complex with the menu button.
tg.text_soon: The assistant chat is coming soon. For now please use the menu buttons.
tg.help: I show the Chinor Park complex: floor plans, apartment statuses, booking and payment. This is a training project — bookings and payments are test ones. Commands: /start, /bookings, /lang, /help. Privacy policy: {privacy}
tg.phone_ok: Thank you! Your number is confirmed.
tg.phone_conflict: This number is already confirmed in another Telegram account. A manager will contact you.
tg.phone_foreign: Please share your own number with the button below.
tg.link_invalid: The link is invalid or out of date. Open the booking page and press the Telegram button again.
tg.linked_elsewhere: This card is already linked to another Telegram account.
tg.staff_invalid: The link code is invalid or expired. Create a new one in the admin: Profile → Link Telegram.
tg.role.head: head of sales
tg.desc: Chinor Park bot: apartments, booking, notifications and a link to a manager. A training project — bookings and payments are test ones.
tpl.hold_created.text: Apartment {apt} is held for you for {min} min. Deposit {deposit} UZS. Pay by {holdUntil}, or the apartment becomes available again.
tpl.payment_failed.text: The payment failed: {reasonText} Apartment {apt} is still held for you until {holdUntil} — you can try again.
tpl.hold_expired.text: The time to pay is over. Apartment {apt} is available for booking again.
tpl.hold_cancelled.text: The sales team cancelled the booking process for apartment {apt}: {reason}.
tpl.booking_confirmed.text: ✅ Apartment {apt} is booked until {until}. Booking {bookingNo}, deposit {deposit} UZS (counted towards the price and the first payment). A manager will contact you. Your booking page is under the button.
tpl.booking_reminder.text: Your booking of apartment {apt} is valid until {until} — {hours} h left. To extend it, write to a manager.
tpl.booking_extended.text: Your booking of apartment {apt} is extended until {until}.
tpl.booking_cancelled.text.client: Your booking of apartment {apt} is cancelled: {reason}. Under the offer terms the deposit is not returned.
tpl.booking_cancelled.text.developer: Your booking of apartment {apt} was cancelled by the developer: {reason}. The deposit of {deposit} UZS will be returned in full.
tpl.booking_expired.text: Your booking of apartment {apt} has expired. Under the offer terms the deposit is not returned. If you still want this apartment, write to us.
tpl.apartment_sold.text: 🎉 Congratulations! Apartment {apt} in Chinor Park is now yours. Thank you for choosing us.
tpl.payment_late.text: The payment arrived after the time to pay was over, so no booking was made. {amount} UZS will be returned automatically.
tpl.refund_done.text: The refund of {amount} UZS for booking {bookingNo} is done.
tpl.refund_done.text.nobooking: The refund of {amount} UZS is done.
tpl.viewing_confirmed.text: You are booked for a viewing of apartment {apt}: {at}. Address: {address}.
tpl.viewing_reminder.text: Reminder: the viewing of apartment {apt} is today at {time}.
tpl.link_telegram_done.text: Done! Notifications about booking {bookingNo} will come here.
tpl.staff_booking_paid.text: 💰 Booking {bookingNo}: apartment {apt} ({rooms}-room, {area} m², {price} UZS). Client: {name}, {phoneMasked}, {channel}. Deposit {deposit} UZS via {provider}. Until {until}. Context: {context}
tpl.staff_apartment_unsold.text: ↩️ The sale of apartment {apt} is cancelled ({staffName}): {reason}
tpl.staff_extend_requested.text: 🙏 The client asks to extend booking {bookingNo} (apt {apt}, until {until}){hoursText}.
